rulings.card: 2025 One Piece OP13-Carrying on His Will St. Marcus Mars Special Alternate Art 091
rulings.why: The OP13-091 red-text parallel: official card list OP13-091_p2, TCGplayer 657368, CGC 'R Red Alt. Art Parallel', about $493 vs about $24. Variant 2255 is the regular Alternate Art (OP13-091_p1, TCGplayer 657367, GemRate 022cf8de, PriceCharting 11012080). Two printings, not one.

rulings.card: 2025 One Piece OP13-Carrying on His Will Sabo Manga Alternate Art 120
rulings.why: The English Manga / Super Alternate Art, TCGplayer 657412. Variant 2272 is the base SEC (TCGplayer 657410, GemRate 0a968e6d). It is none of the other Sabo variants either: 1739 is the English Parallel (657413), 1759 the Wanted Poster SP (657414), 2119 the Japanese Manga.
